title: Film test
description: A test bench for the lab's shared film look. One photograph of cumulus over a narrow street, raw on the left of the split and developed on the right: halation, Pro-Mist diffusion, dye-cloud colour bleed, a film curve that lets the cloud glow instead of clip, a deeper summer blue, fine grain and an optical vignette. Drag sideways to move the split.
intent: Tune src/app/lab/_kit/film.js against herb's references (scanned Portra 400 / Fuji Superia / CineStill summer skies), not a VHS or bloom filter. ?preset=summer|dusk|night, any film param as a query override, ?motion=1 for moving grain.
